import json, subprocess, sys, time
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"

     "fallback":full(7)}
raw=json.dumps(cfg).encode()
print("config bytes:", len(raw))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=30)
dt=time.time()-t0
print("compile %.2fs rc=%d out=%d bytes"%(dt,p.returncode,len(p.stdout)))
prog=json.loads(p.stdout)
